item.title: Show HN: The Digital Junk Drawer – a shoebox of tiny web apps
item.summary: a little site that's basically a shoebox of micro web apps, mini games, and pointless-but-fun tools. It's open source, and anyone can add their own app to it too (just drop in an HTML file + thumbnail and open a PR).
